compliance.emc: FCC 47 CFR Part 15, ICES-003, BS EN 55032, BS EN 55035, EN 300 386, CISPR 32, CISPR 35, IEC/EN 61000 series (datasheet)
compliance.materials: RoHS 6/6, China RoHS, REACH, WEEE; power supply efficiency 80 Plus Silver (datasheet)
compliance.seismic: tested and meets GR-63 (guide Table 21); designed for GR-63 Zone 4 (datasheet)
compliance.telco: GR-1089-Core Issue 8; Deutsche Telekom 1TR9; BT GS7; CLEI code (datasheet)

environmental.humidity: 55 to 70 percent non-condensing (guide Table 21; the datasheet prints 5 to 90 percent)
environmental.operating-temp: 0 C to 40 C (datasheet; the guide's Table 21 prints the same range as the non-operating temperature)
environmental.storage-temp: -40 C to 85 C shipping and storage (guide Table 21; the datasheet prints 70 C)

features.timing: BITS RJ-45 jack, 10 MHz and PPS SMB connectors in and out, on each Routing and Control Board

management.console: CON RJ-45 serial on the Routing and Control Board
management.oob: MGMT RJ-45 on the Routing and Control Board, autosensing 10/100/1000 with link and activity lamps
management.usb: one USB 2.0/3.0 port on the Routing and Control Board

performance.line-cards: FPC 0 to 7 take QFX5K-FPC-4CD (4 x 400G), QFX5K-FPC-16C (16 x 100G) or QFX5K-FPC-20Y (20 x 10/25/50G); at most 144 logical ports
performance.throughput: up to 12.8 Tbps unidirectional, 25.6 Tbps bidirectional (datasheet Table 1)

physical.cable-manager: 6RU with the cable management system fitted (guide, QFX5700 Physical Specifications)
physical.weight-note: with all FRUs installed (guide Table 5; datasheet Table 2)

platform.cpu: Intel Hewitt Lake 6-core x86 at 2.9 GHz in each Routing and Control Board
platform.memory: 32 GB DDR4 (two 16 GB DIMMs), expandable to 64 GB
platform.storage: two 100 GB M.2 SATA or NVMe SSDs per Routing and Control Board

power.power-max-scope: eight QFX5K-FPC-16C cards, 40 C, SR optics, 100 percent IMIX load, MACsec on (guide Table 9); the 20Y and 4CD builds are 1622 W and 1762 W
power.power-typical-scope: eight QFX5K-FPC-16C cards, 25 C, 50 percent IMIX load, no MACsec, no transceivers (guide Table 9); the 20Y and 4CD builds are 751 W and 1095 W
power.psu-input-ac: 200 to 277 VAC rated, 180 to 305 VAC, 47 to 63 Hz; the supplies detect HVDC (190 to 400 VDC) as well (guide Table 8)
power.psu-input-dc: 40 to 72 VDC, rated 48 to 60 VDC; the input current selector sets 60 A (2700 W, 2200 W under the warning voltage) or 80 A (3000 W) (guide Tables 12)

occupant-attrs.data-description: the two M6 earthing studs at the left of the rear row

configs.description: QFX5700-BASE-AC: the base configuration with AC/HVDC supplies - one QFX5700-RCB (slot 0) with the blank for the other RCB slot, one QFX5700-FEB, two JNP-3000W-AC-AFO supplies with blanks over the other two power slots, two JNP5700-FAN trays and a blank (JNP5K-FPC-BLNK) over every FPC slot (guide Table 27; datasheet "mit 1 5700-FEB, 1 RCB, redundanten Luefter, 2 AC-Netzteilen, Front-to-Back-Luftstrom"). Airflow is front to back only. The line cards and the cable manager ship separately.
configs.name: ac

configs.description: The AC chassis as a first look: one routing board, two supplies, two fan trays, every line-card slot blanked.
configs.name: base

configs.description: QFX5700-CHAS, the spare chassis (datasheet: "QFX5700/QFX5700E - spare chassis"). What it ships with is not stated, so every bay is shown open: no Routing and Control Board, no line-card blank, no power supply and no fan tray.
configs.name: chas

configs.description: QFX5700-BASE-DC: the base configuration with DC supplies - two JNP-3000W-DC-AFO supplies in PSU 0 and PSU 1, the rest as the AC build. Each supply has a single feed, so feeds A and B go one to each.
configs.name: dc

configs.description: QFX5700E-BASE-AC: the QFX5700E with AC/HVDC supplies. It has the same front and rear as the QFX5700 and differs in its internal forwarding engine board, QFX5700E-FEB in place of QFX5700-FEB, which is not drawn on either face (datasheet ordering information; guide Table 18). The datasheet's software scale differs for the E (96,000 MAC addresses against 160,000).
configs.name: e-ac

configs.description: QFX5700E-BASE-DC: the QFX5700E with DC supplies, as QFX5700E-BASE-AC but with two JNP-3000W-DC-AFO supplies in PSU 0 and PSU 1.
configs.name: e-dc

gaps.wanted: what QFX5700-CHAS ships with. The datasheet calls it a spare chassis ("QFX5700/QFX5700E - Ersatzgehaeuse") and the guide's Table 27 lists only the base configuration. It is modelled with every bay open; whether it ships with the FPC blanks, the midplane only or the front brackets is not stated.

a redundant (four supply) build. Neither the guide nor the datasheet lists an orderable one: the base configuration has two supplies, and the guide says all four must be fitted for power redundancy. The four-supply population is a population of the PSU bays, not a SKU.
a photograph or figure of an empty RCB slot or of the JNP5K-RCB-BLNK blank, and of the power-slot blank (which the guide gives no code); both blanks are drawn plain from the openings they cover.
a flat figure or photograph of the QFX5700 DC supply face (the guide's figure 33 is an isometric); the reused part draws it from the AC supply's outline.

the guide's Table 21 (storage -40 to 85 C, humidity 55 to 70 percent) against the datasheet (storage -40 to 70 C, humidity 5 to 90 percent operating and 5 to 95 percent not operating). The guide's are carried.
the photograph prints nothing on the slot 8 blank and the drawing shows the same latches and screws as a card; the blank is drawn from the drawing.

a `power-draw-max-w` on each module this chassis accepts, from the vendor's own per-card table - Cisco publishes one per ambient, most vendors publish none, and until they land a module total is a floor
`physical-context` on 17 bays (front 11, rear 6) - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays

chassis.note: guide Table 5 and datasheet Table 2: 48.2 cm wide, 22.2 cm high, 81.5 cm deep, 5RU, 69.8 kg with all FRUs installed (the datasheet prints the same). The 48.2 cm is over the front brackets: the flat front figure measures 482.6 mm from ear to ear (1443 px at 2.990 px/mm) and the body between the fold lines 440.8 mm (1318 px). The body is modelled and the ears are not drawn, as every library chassis is; the height is 5RU, 222.25 mm, of which the guide's 22.2 cm is the rounded figure. The depth is taken as the table states it; the table does not say whether it is over the fan tray handles. The rack kit is JNP5K-RMK-4POST (datasheet, additional SKUs; the guide's four-post mounting procedure uses front brackets and rear mounting blades); it is named here and not modelled, since no position or kit range is stated in a form the library can take.

color.note: photo - mid grey chassis, silver line cards and blanks, dark grey fan trays with black handles, orange supply handles.

esd.note: guide, figures 4, 16 and 17: an ESD point at the bottom of the model plate (front) and at the right end of the PSU row (rear), each a recessed socket with the warning triangle beside it. The front socket is at (428.3, 195.0) and the rear one at (425.2, 9.9).

feb.note: NOT A BAY OR A PLACEMENT. The forwarding engine board (QFX5700-FEB, or QFX5700E-FEB in the QFX5700E build) lies horizontally mid-chassis, between the FPCs and the RCB at the front and the fan trays at the rear, and is not visible from outside: one fan tray has to come out to see it (guide, Forwarding Engine Board). It is 8.4 cm high, 43.7 cm wide and 28.1 cm deep, 6.6 kg and 300 W (Table 18), has two lamps and an online/offline button (Table 19), and the base configuration includes one with a blank for the empty FEB slot (JNP5K-FEB-BLNK, datasheet). Nothing of it shows on either face: the fan trays' FEB lamp is the only mark. It is left out.

front.note: drawing - figure 16 at 2.990 px/mm: two RCB bays 198.8 by 30.8 mm at x 12.7 and 226.4 (y 7.6); nine FPC bays 44.3 by 168.2 mm at y 45.5, on a 44.95 mm pitch from x 12.4; the model plate 20.4 mm wide at x 419.1. The slot labels FPC 0 and 1 to 8 run along the bottom edge (y 218), and RCB 0 and RCB 1 sit under the boards' left ends. The counts agree with the photograph (figure 8) and with the guide's text (two RCB slots, nine FPC slots of which eight are supported).

gate-1.note: The flat front figure (figure 16, g101401, 1500 px wide) is 1443 px from ear to ear and 665 px from the top edge to the bottom edge: an aspect of 2.170 against the table's 482.6 / 222.25 = 2.171, so it is orthographic, and 2.990 px/mm serves both axes. Origin at the left fold (x 83 px) and the top edge (y 237 px). The flat rear figure (figure 17, g101403) is 1413 px from ear to ear, so 2.928 px/mm across; its body is 1289 px, 440.2 mm, agreeing with the front's 440.8 to 0.1 percent. Its height reads 669 px from top to bottom lip, 228 mm, 2.8 percent over the table's, so the rear's vertical positions are taken from its top edge at 2.928 px/mm and carry that uncertainty (up to 3 mm at the bottom tray). Origin at the left fold (x 101 px) and the top edge (y 176 px).

grounding.note: guide, Connect the QFX5700 Switch to Earth Ground and figure 35: the lugs are dual hole and fit M6 at 15.86 mm (0.625 in.) centres, which is the library's 5/8 in. M6 pair (15.875 mm). The two studs are drawn at the left of the rear row, one above the other, at a measured 15.5 mm; the pair is common/ground-stud-pair-5-8-m6@1, turned 90 and centred on their midpoint. The rear photograph shows two cross-head screws in place of the studs, which is what the pair draws.

left-out.note: LEFT OUT OF THIS SLICE, by part number. The line cards are a family of their own: QFX5K-FPC-16C (16 x QSFP28 or QSFP+, 100G or 40G), QFX5K-FPC-20Y (20 x SFP56, SFP28 or SFP+, the first 16 usable in slots 1, 3, 5 and 7) and QFX5K-FPC-4CD (4 x QSFP56-DD, 400G); the guide's Table 4 and photograph print JNP-FPC16C and JNP-FPC4CD on the cards' labels. The forwarding engine board QFX5700-FEB and QFX5700E-FEB and its blank JNP5K-FEB-BLNK. The cable manager QFX5K-EMI (6RU with it fitted; it covers the front, so the port side shown here is without it), the rack kit JNP5K-RMK-4POST and the optional licences and power cords. Each FPC slot shows its blank.

lifecycle.note: searched 2026-10-23: Juniper's end-of-life pages and the third-party aggregators list no end-of-sale or end-of-life notice for the QFX5700; none is carried, so the state is none-announced. The search was by the model name and was not a read of Juniper's support milestones table.

other-faces.note: no flat figure shows the top, bottom or either side. The guide's isometric (figure 14) shows six square vents on the right side wall and the clearance figures (43 and 44) only a plan and elevation outline. These faces are left empty.

power.note: guide Table 9 and datasheet: fully loaded with eight cards of one kind, typical 751 W (8 QFX5K-FPC-20Y), 1259 W (8 QFX5K-FPC-16C) or 1095 W (8 QFX5K-FPC-4CD), maximum 1622, 2271 or 1762 W. Typical is at 25 C, 50 percent load and IMIX traffic without MACsec and without transceivers; maximum is at 40 C with SR optics and 100 percent IMIX traffic, with MACsec on the 20Y and 16C cards and without it on the 4CD card, measured at 200 to 277 VAC. The heaviest of the three is carried, since this device holds no card; the cards themselves are not modelled. The supplies are 3000 W each (Table 8: AC 180 to 305 V, 47 to 63 Hz; DC 40 to 72 V). Each module's own draw is stated on its contract where the guide gives one (the RCB 80 W); the fan trays' is not published.

power-supplies.note: guide, Table 4, figures 13 and 30 to 34 and the power sections: four 3000 W supplies, PSU 0 to PSU 3, "you can install the power supplies in any slot", load-sharing, each with its own fans (two counter-rotating fans, front to back); JNP-3000W-AC-AFO (product 740-073765, AC or HVDC) or JNP-3000W-DC-AFO (740-073766); AC and DC are never mixed. Table 27 ships two in the base configuration with two blanks for the empty slots. These are the part numbers the QFX5230-64CD uses for its supplies, so juniper/qfx5230-jnp-3000w-ac-afo@1 and juniper/qfx5230-jnp-3000w-dc-afo@1 are reused unchanged. The reused face is photo-measured at 74.8 by 40.2 mm; the rear figure here measures 73.9 by 40.4 mm, and Table 5 gives 7.4 by 4.4 cm, so the height conflicts by 3.8 mm and the figure agrees with the reused part. The handle is orange in the guide's callout (figure 30) and in the photograph. Airflow is front-to-back only (air out, AFO): the QFX5700 has no back-to-front build.

rcb.note: guide, figures 14 to 16 and the RCB section: two RCB slots, RCB 0 on the left and RCB 1 on the right, with the boards kept upside down. The guide says the QFX5700 supports no RCB or FEB redundancy: a system has one board of each, in slot 0 or slot 1, and the two go in the same slot number. Table 27 ships one QFX5700-RCB and one JNP5K-RCB-BLNK in the base configuration. The guide does not say which slot the shipped board goes in; slot 0 is modelled.

rear.note: drawing - figure 17 at 2.928 px/mm: four PSU bays at x 32.0, 132.4, 232.7 and 332.9 (y 1.9, 74.8 by 40.2 mm, a pitch of 100.4 mm), with a label plate between PSU 0 and 1 and another between PSU 2 and 3; the earth studs at the left (centre x 12.5, y 18.3 and 33.8) with the earth symbol at 23.4, 8.6; the ESD jack at the right (425.2, 9.9) with the warning label under it; two fan trays 426.6 mm wide and 85 mm high at y 45.2 and 131.3, the upper numbered 1 and the lower 0 (FAN TRAY 1, FAN TRAY 0 in a screw column at the right edge).

rear-vs-photo.note: sources-disagree on the face and the photograph wins: the guide's drawing prints a fan symbol beside 0 to 3 on each fan tray's status panel; the photograph (figure 9) prints FAN 0 to FAN 3 and FEB, and shows the tray faces dark grey with black handles and the PSU handle orange. The drawing prints the model plate and the RCB label as QFX5700 and QFX5700-RCB; the photograph prints JNP5700 and JNP5700-RCB. The legends below are the photograph's. The photograph also prints RUNNING and a maker's name under the model on the plate: the maker's name is a mark and is reserved as the logo zone, and the rest is not carried.

slots.note: guide, Table 4 and the FPC section: FPC n is 0 to 7, "the chassis has nine FPC slots, but the chassis supports only eight FPCs in slots FPC 0 through 7. Slot 8 is empty"; figures 14 to 16 call it the "unsupported slot". Table 27 ships nine JNP5K-FPC-BLNK blanks in the base configuration, one for each of the nine, so slot 8 is modelled as a bay that accepts the blank only. The brief for this model said eight FPC slots; the guide draws and counts nine.

sources.note: QFX5700 Switch Hardware Guide, published 2026-09-30, 241 pages (copyright 2026 Hewlett Packard Enterprise Development LP, the owner of Juniper Networks), from https://www.juniper.net/documentation/us/en/hardware/qfx5700/qfx5700.pdf (the address worked; no other was used): the front and rear photographs (figures 8 and 9, g101491 and g101492), the flat front and rear figures (figures 16 and 17, g101401 and g101403), Table 3 (FRUs), Table 4 (CLI names), the cooling system (figures 27 to 29, Tables 6 and 7), the power system (figures 30 to 34, Tables 8 to 12), the physical specifications (Table 5), the RCB (figures 36 and 37, Tables 13 and 14), the FPCs (figures 38 to 40, Tables 15 to 17), the forwarding engine board (Tables 18 and 19), the environmental tolerances (Table 21), the base configuration order (Table 27) and the accessory kit (Table 28). QFX5700 Switch datasheet, Juniper document 1000719-009, September 2024, from https://www.juniper.net/content/dam/www/assets/datasheets/de/de/switches/qfx5700-switch-datasheet.pdf (the German edition: the English address, www.juniper.net/content/dam/www/assets/datasheets/us/en/switches/qfx5700-switch-datasheet.pdf, redirects to the HPE document a00150803enw, which needs a browser). The datasheet's tables are numbers and part numbers; the German prose is not relied on. Both are the maker's and public; neither states terms of use beyond the copyright notice, so only facts are transcribed and no drawing or photograph is copied. No separate Juniper image-library photograph of the QFX5700 was found: the photographs of figures 8 and 9 in the guide are the photographs used. No Visio stencil, 3D model or mechanical drawing was found.

sources-disagree.note: two documents of the maker, one device: the guide's Table 21 prints altitude 6000 ft (1828 m), relative humidity 55 to 70 percent non-condensing, non-operating temperature 0 to 40 C and shipping and storage -40 to 85 C. The datasheet (September 2024) prints operating 0 to 40 C, storage -40 to 70 C, altitude up to 1828.8 m, humidity 5 to 90 percent non-condensing (5 to 95 percent not operating). The altitude agrees. The newer document is the guide (2026-09-30) and its figures are carried; the datasheet's are listed in the gaps. The datasheet also prints the supplies as 300 W where the guide and the part numbers say 3000 W: a misprint.

vents.note: drawing - the vent fields of the top edge, the left rail and the plate's slot grid are drawn as vent decor at the figures' extents; the real punching follows each feature hole for hole and is not reproduced.
